asr.full_text: Restaurants are making big bucks on us, but that's nothing compared to the numbers Tom Cruise is running up at the movie theaters. This past weekend he proved he can still blow up at the box office, especially when he's in action. Setting cruise control at FAST is our first story, trending now. Mission Impossible Fallout was the franchise's biggest opening ever with over $61 million and the second highest for crews only behind War of the Worlds. One thing that seems to help when he's running. I'm sorry, John, but you're gonna have to run again. Rotten Tomatoes crunched the numbers and found that if he sprints over a thousand feet in a movie, the Tomatometer rating is higher and so are the box office numbers. Mission Impossible 3 was his most Fitbit-intensive film, with him totaling more than 3,200 feet. Movies like Valkyrie and Lions for Lambs, where his fastest ride seems to be a walk, bring in low numbers and rotten ratings. Now here's a thought, maybe if he did more moving and less shaking in Cocktail, it could have helped that film's 5% rating. Speaking of which, you want to guess in what state people spend the most money on Amazon? The state of intoxication. Yep, shopping carts are getting filled by shoppers who are half in the bag. Don't Drink in Prime is at number two. And Alexa, order bath salts on Prime now. Mineral bath salts can be delivered between 8 p.m. and 10 p.m. tonight. Yes. Amazon has made buying easy with Alexa and one-click shopping, which is probably why, according to a Finder.com survey, people spent more than $30 billion while drunk last year. They also found that nearly half of those polled admitted to shopping while in a state of lowered inhibition. A different survey showed pie-eyed purchasers spent on average about $40. And what they drink is also a factor. Gin drinkers spend up to $80, while whiskey drinkers spend about $39. Help yourself and your wallet by using self-blocking apps like Focus Me and Freedom. Don't rely on your willpower to stop. Get freedom. After all that spending here is some music to your ears. Free food. Chipotle is celebrating millennials' favorite holiday today, Avocado Day. Rock the Guac is at number three. What is this unusual thing? This attractive rounded object. It is an avocado. Chipotle is offering free guac. If you buy a meal online or through their app using the code avocado guacamole, a delicious avocado compound is mashed fresh in Chipotle's kitchens each day. National Avocado Day was started last year by the ladies of Model Meals as a way to profess their love of the fruit. Get a list of more restaurants giving out guac at thelisttv.com. I cannot watch that footage without getting hungry. That's right, time to grab the chips and guac. That's what's trending now.
